svg.text: BACK PANEL 105 (1:2), SEEN FROM THE FRONT (DOOR OPEN)
DIN 35 rails at z 180 / 330 / 480; duct 40 x 60 between rows; A1 needs 50 above and below (airflow)
0 V bonded to PE at G1
1. Build to UL 508A practice: SCCR 5 kA marked on the door, wire colours: black power, white neutral, red +24, blue 0 V, green/yellow PE.
2. Point-to-point check and hi-pot (500 V DC insulation ≥ 1 MΩ on power circuits, PLC and drive disconnected) before power-on (ITP T13).
3. Head cables (W1, W1E, W2, W4) run up inside the column through the Ø60 passes and leave by the Ø40 hole in head plate 301; leave a 200 loop for head adjustment.
